note: Synthetic help-centre passages for a fictional product, in first-stage order. Only restore-window answers the query.
query: How long can I still restore a project after deleting it?

candidates.title: Archive a project
candidates.text: Archiving a project makes it read-only and hides it from the dashboard. Archived projects are kept until an owner unarchives or deletes them.

candidates.title: Projects API
candidates.text: DELETE /projects/{id} moves the project to the trash. Add ?permanent=true to delete it at once, without the trash.

candidates.title: File history
candidates.text: Every file keeps its earlier versions for 60 days. Restoring a version of one file does not change any other file in the project.

candidates.title: Deleted projects
candidates.text: A deleted project stays in the trash for 30 days, and an owner can restore it from Settings, Trash. After 30 days it is purged and cannot be recovered.

candidates.title: Backups
candidates.text: The database is backed up every night and each backup is kept for 14 days. Backups are for disaster recovery and cannot be used to bring back a single project.

candidates.title: Close an account
candidates.text: When an account is closed, its projects are deleted 90 days later and their export links stop working.

candidates.title: Who can see the trash
candidates.text: Only project owners can open the trash. A member who deleted something by mistake can ask an owner to restore it.

candidates.title: Export a project
candidates.text: Owners can export a project as a ZIP file at any time. The download link expires after 24 hours.

candidates.title: Storage quota
candidates.text: A project stops counting towards the storage quota as soon as it is deleted.

candidates.title: Audit log
candidates.text: The audit log records who deleted or restored each project and keeps every entry for one year.
